verses.original: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh nap̄·šî ’eś·śā
verses.literal: Of David To You O LORD I lift up my soul
verses.literalPt: A TI, SENHOR, levanto a minha alma.

verses.original: אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־ אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־ יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕlō·hay bə·ḵā ḇā·ṭaḥ·tî ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh ’al- ya·‘al·ṣū ’ō·yə·ḇay lî
verses.literal: in You my God I trust Do not let me be put to shame do not let my enemies exult over me
verses.literalPt: Deus meu, em ti confio, não me deixes confundido, nem que os meus inimigos triunfem sobre mim.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כָּל־ קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gam kāl- qō·we·ḵā lō yê·ḇō·šū yê·ḇō·šū hab·bō·wḡ·ḏîm rê·qām
verses.literal: Surely . . . none who wait for You will be put to shame but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, não serão confundidos os que esperam em ti; confundidos serão os que transgridem sem causa.

verses.original: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: də·rā·ḵe·ḵā Yah·weh hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî ’ō·rə·ḥō·w·ṯe·ḵā lam·mə·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: Show me Your ways O LORD teach me Your paths
verses.literalPt: Faze-me saber os teus caminhos, SENHOR; ensina-me as tuas veredas.

verses.original: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: haḏ·rî·ḵê·nî ḇa·’ă·mit·te·ḵā wə·lam·mə·ḏê·nî kî- ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘î ’ō·wṯ·ḵā qiw·wî·ṯî kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Guide me in Your truth and teach me for You are the God of my salvation all day long I wait for You
verses.literalPt: Guia-me na tua verdade, e ensina-me, pois tu és o Deus da minha salvação; por ti estou esperando todo o dia.

verses.original: זְכֹר־ רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr- ra·ḥă·me·ḵā Yah·weh wa·ḥă·sā·ḏe·ḵā kî mê·‘ō·w·lām hêm·māh
verses.literal: Remember O LORD Your compassion and loving devotion for they are from age to age
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te, SENHOR, das tuas misericórdias e das tuas benignidades, porque são desde a eternidade.

verses.original: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־ תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר־ לִי־ אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ nə·‘ū·ray ū·p̄ə·šā·‘ay ’al- tiz·kōr kə·ḥas·də·ḵā zə·ḵār- lî- ’at·tāh lə·ma·‘an ṭū·ḇə·ḵā Yah·weh
verses.literal: Remember not the sins of my youth nor my rebellious acts remember me according to Your loving devotion . . . because of Your goodness O LORD
verses.literalPt: Não te lembres dos pecados da minha mocidade, nem das minhas transgressões; mas segundo a tua misericórdia, lembra-te de mim, por tua bondade, SENHOR.

verses.original: טוֹב־ וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- wə·yā·šār Yah·weh ‘al- kên yō·w·reh ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: Good and upright is the LORD therefore . . . He shows sinners the way
verses.literalPt: Bom e reto é o SENHOR; por isso ensinará o caminho aos pecadores.

verses.original: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḏ·rêḵ ‘ă·nā·wîm bam·miš·pāṭ wî·lam·mêḏ ‘ă·nā·wîm dar·kōw
verses.literal: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way
verses.literalPt: Guiará os mansos em justiça e aos mansos ensinará o seu caminho.

verses.original: כָּל־ אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ Yah·weh ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ lə·nō·ṣə·rê ḇə·rî·ṯōw wə·‘ê·ḏō·ṯāw
verses.literal: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful . . . to those who keep His covenant and His decrees
verses.literalPt: Todas as veredas do SENHOR são misericórdia e verdade para aqueles que guardam a sua aliança e os seus testemunhos.

verses.original: לְמַֽעַן־ שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an- šim·ḵā Yah·weh wə·sā·laḥ·tā la·‘ă·wō·nî kî raḇ- hū
verses.literal: For the sake of Your name O LORD forgive my iniquity for it is great
verses.literalPt: Por amor do teu nome, SENHOR, perdoa a minha iniqüidade, pois é grande.

verses.original: מִי־ זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mî- zeh hā·’îš yə·rê Yah·weh yō·w·ren·nū bə·ḏe·reḵ yiḇ·ḥār
verses.literal: Who . . . is the man who fears the LORD He will instruct him in the path chosen for him
verses.literalPt: Qual é o homem que teme ao SENHOR? Ele o ensinará no caminho que deve escolher.

verses.original: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šōw bə·ṭō·wḇ tā·lîn wə·zar·‘ōw yî·raš ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: His soul will dwell in prosperity and his descendants will inherit the land
verses.literalPt: A sua alma pousará no bem, e a sua semente herdará a terra.

verses.original: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: sō·wḏ Yah·weh lî·rê·’āw ū·ḇə·rî·ṯōw lə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ām
verses.literal: The LORD confides in those who fear Him and reveals His covenant to them
verses.literalPt: O segredo do SENHOR é com aqueles que o temem; e ele lhes mostrará a sua aliança.

verses.original: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־ יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nay tā·mîḏ ’el- Yah·weh kî hū- yō·w·ṣî mê·re·šeṯ raḡ·lāy
verses.literal: My eyes are always on the LORD for He will free my feet from the mesh
verses.literalPt: Os meus olhos estão continuamente no SENHOR, pois ele tirará os meus pés da rede.

verses.original: פְּנֵה־ אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־ יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nêh- ’ê·lay wə·ḥān·nê·nî kî- yā·ḥîḏ wə·‘ā·nî ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Turn to me and be gracious for I am lonely and afflicted
verses.literalPt: Olha para mim, e tem piedade de mim, porque estou solitário e aflito.

verses.original: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ṣā·rō·wṯ lə·ḇā·ḇî hir·ḥî·ḇū mim·mə·ṣū·qō·w·ṯay hō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî
verses.literal: The troubles of my heart increase free me from my distress
verses.literalPt: As ânsias do meu coração se têm multiplicado; tira-me dos meus apertos.

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל־ חַטֹּאותָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh ‘ā·nə·yî wa·‘ă·mā·lî wə·śā lə·ḵāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: Consider my affliction and trouble and take away all my sins
verses.literalPt: Olha para a minha aflição e para a minha dor, e perdoa todos os meus pecados.

verses.original: רְאֵֽה־ אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־ רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh- ’ō·wy·ḇay kî- rāb·bū wə·śin·’aṯ ḥā·mās śə·nê·’ū·nî
verses.literal: Consider my enemies for they are many and they hate me with vicious hatred
verses.literalPt: Olha para os meus inimigos, pois se vão multiplicando e me odeiam com ódio cruel.

verses.original: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־ אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rāh nap̄·šî wə·haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wōš kî- ḥā·sî·ṯî ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Guard my soul and deliver me let me not be put to shame for I take refuge in You
verses.literalPt: Guarda a minha alma, e livra-me; não me deixes confundido, porquanto confio em ti.

verses.original: תֹּם־ וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tōm- wā·yō·šer yiṣ·ṣə·rū·nî kî qiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā
verses.literal: May integrity and uprightness preserve me because I wait for You
verses.literalPt: Guardem-me a sinceridade e a retidão, porquanto espero em ti.

verses.original: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו׃
verses.transliteration: pə·ḏêh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mik·kōl ṣå̄·rō·ṯå̄w
verses.literal: Redeem Israel O God from all its distress
verses.literalPt: Redime, ó Deus, a Israel de todas as suas angústias.
